caption: A battery-powered lantern in a tent is switched on, and the tent lights up.

sa.check: The lantern is battery powered: no cord runs from it.
The order is dark, switch, lit.

pc.expect: The lantern lights at the moment its switch is moved, and only then.
pc.fail: The switch is moved and the lantern stays dark; or the tent is lit before the switch is touched; or the lantern comes on with nothing touching it; or the tent brightens while the lantern stays dark.

pc.expect: Once on, the lantern stays lit steadily and the tent stays lit for the rest of the clip.
pc.fail: The lantern goes out again by itself; or flickers; or dims back to dark; or the switch moves back by itself.

pc.expect: The light comes from the lantern: the tent's walls and floor brighten most nearest it, and shadows of objects point away from it.
pc.fail: The lantern glows while the tent walls stay as dark as before; or the light comes from a place other than the lantern; or shadows point toward the lantern; or the tent is lit evenly with no brighter side.

pc.expect: The lantern stays where it is as it is switched on; the tent and its contents stay put.
pc.fail: The lantern slides or swings with nothing touching it; or the tent walls billow at the switch; or objects in the tent shift.

pc.expect: One lantern; the tent's contents are the same before and after; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: A second lantern appears; or objects appear or vanish between dark and lit frames; or the hand passes through the lantern; or the tent changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The tent's fabric colour, the lantern's colour and the gear inside stay the same apart from brightness.
pc.fail: The fabric changes colour rather than brightness; or the lantern changes colour; or the gear rearranges.
